title: DLCA: Dynamic life cycle assessment for buildings
description:
DLCA is a Python package for dynamic life cycle assessment of buildings. It models greenhouse-gas emissions as they occur over time, rather than lumping them into a single point in time, and reports cumulative global warming impact (GWI) and global temperature change potential (GTP) over the chosen study period.

DLCA is released under the MIT licence, except two packaged data files (Cambium 2024 extracts from NLR), which carry NLR's own terms; see src/dlca/data/CAMBIUM_NOTICE.md.
